fields.h1: Build a Wedding Photography Questionnaire That Plans the Day
fields.hero_description: Build a wedding photography questionnaire that checks the couple's timeline and formals list and saves both to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: Questions That Turn Into the Day's Plan
fields.features_subheading: A wedding photography questionnaire is the form a couple fills in before the wedding. Here, each section feeds one part of your plan.
fields.feature_1:
One section for each part of the day

The questionnaire takes the couple through getting ready, the ceremony, formals, and the reception, in the order they happen. Each section asks only what you need for that part.
fields.feature_2:
Names spelled the way they sound

The couple adds a phonetic spelling beside each name you will call during formals, like Siobhan (shi-VAWN). You read it off the list instead of guessing in front of the family.
fields.feature_3:
Follow-up questions only when they apply

A couple who plans a first look is asked where and at what time. A couple who skips it never sees those two questions, and the form moves straight on to the ceremony questions.
fields.feature_4:
A reminder before the due date

Pick a due date, such as 30 days before the wedding. If any section is still blank a week before it, the app emails the couple a reminder that names the sections left to finish.
fields.feature_5:
Every wedding in a database you own

Each couple's answers save as one row in a database you own, with no response caps. A full season of weddings sits in one table, and a filter by wedding date pulls up next month.
fields.feature_6:
Code you can move to GitHub

On paid plans, the full code of the questionnaire and its database exports to your GitHub repository. Keep it with your studio's other code, or give a developer the repository.

fields.usecase_heading: What Four Studios Learn From the Answers
fields.tab_content_1:
June 12 is booked, which the couple sees first

Callowhill Photo shoots one wedding a day. Isaura Seferis and Emrys Pollard open its inquiry questionnaire and ask about Saturday, June 12, 2027. The form checks that date against the studio's booked weddings and says on the first screen that it is taken. Their answers save to the waitlist with the date they wanted.
fields.tab_content_2:
Past 9:00 pm, no photographer for the sparklers

Inchbald Studio sells an 8-hour package, and for Linnet Tullis and Yannick Faraday it starts at 1:00 pm and ends at 9:00 pm. In the timeline section they list a sparkler exit at 9:45 pm. The questionnaire marks the exit 45 minutes past coverage and asks them to move it or add an hour.
fields.tab_content_3:
The couple cuts 4 groupings when formals run long

Coriander Lane Studio allows 3 minutes per family grouping and holds 30 minutes for formals after the ceremony. Seren Batista and Florentin Merritt list 14 groupings, which comes to 42 minutes. The form shows them the 12-minute overrun, and they cut 4 groupings to leave 10 before they submit.
fields.tab_content_4:
For Emeka, the planner's arrival time a week out

Seawhistle Photo asks each couple who their planner and DJ are, and when each one starts. Seven days before the wedding, the app emails those answers to the second shooter, Emeka Thorsen. His email names the planner, Gwendolyn Pembury, arriving at 2:00 pm, and puts the grand entrance at 6:30 pm.

fields.howto_title: How to Make a Wedding Photo Questionnaire
fields.howto_description: The steps below turn your planning notes into a wedding photography questionnaire that couples finish before the wedding.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Gather the questions you already ask
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Order the sections like the day
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Put your numbers into the rules
fields.howto_step_1_des: Collect the questions you already send couples by email in the weeks before a wedding. Mark the ones whose answers change your plan, like the ceremony start or a second getting-ready location. Those go into the questionnaire first, and the rest earn a place only if you use them.
fields.howto_step_2_des: List the sections as the day runs: getting ready, first look, ceremony, family formals, reception, and exit. Under each one, list the questions you ask on every wedding, and add the ones a couple's earlier emails tell you to ask.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Note the numbers your plan depends on: the hours in each package, how many minutes you give each family grouping, and how long the formals window runs. These become the rules that flag a sparkler exit after coverage or a list that runs long.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Describe the questionnaire to Emergent in plain English, with your sections and the rules from step 3. Emergent builds the working form and the database behind it. Read the first version as a couple would, then ask for changes by prompting again.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Set the reminder and vendor email
fields.howto_step_5_des: Pick the due date for the final questionnaire and the day a reminder goes out if a section is still blank. If you work with a second shooter, ask for the vendor answers to be emailed to them before the wedding as well.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Fill it in as a couple
fields.howto_step_6_des: Open the published questionnaire and answer it as a couple with a long family list and a late exit. Check that the formals total is right, the exit is flagged, and the row in your database shows every answer you entered.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Send the link once the date is booked
fields.howto_step_7_des: Send the final questionnaire link in the email that confirms the booking, with the due date in the first line. Answers arrive as one row per wedding, and you plan from that row instead of a long email thread.

faq_plan.q: What is a wedding photography questionnaire?
faq_plan.a: A wedding photography questionnaire is the set of questions a photographer sends a couple before the wedding. It collects the timeline of the day, the family groupings for formals, the names of people who matter, and the vendors the photographer will work beside. The answers become the photographer's plan for the day.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a wedding photography questionnaire?
faq_plan.a: Describe it to Emergent's AI form builder in plain English: the sections you want and the rules it should check, like a sparkler exit that falls after your coverage ends. Emergent builds the questionnaire and the database behind it, and you change it later by prompting again. The free tier covers building and publishing.

faq_plan.q: What should I change in a wedding photography questionnaire template?
faq_plan.a: Change everything that depends on how you shoot. Reorder the template's sections to match the way your weddings run, put in your coverage hours, and delete the questions you never use. Then add what the template leaves out, such as a getting-ready address for each partner or a rain plan for an outdoor ceremony.

faq_plan.q: When should couples fill out a wedding photography questionnaire?
faq_plan.a: After they book, once the wedding photography contract is signed, and early enough that you can plan from the answers. Set a due date a few weeks before the wedding, and keep the week after it free to call the couple about anything unclear.

faq_plan.q: How do I collect family photo groupings in a wedding photography questionnaire?
faq_plan.a: Ask for one grouping per line, with every person named, in the order you want to shoot them. Add a box for anything you should know before formals start, like a grandparent who needs a chair or relatives who would rather not stand together. Read the list back to the couple if any name looks unclear.

faq_plan.q: What timeline questions belong in a wedding photography questionnaire?
faq_plan.a: Ask for the time and place of every moment you will shoot: getting ready, a first look, the ceremony, cocktail hour, introductions, toasts, the first dance, the cake, and the exit. Ask who keeps the official timeline, such as a planner or the venue coordinator, and get their copy too.

faq_plan.q: How is an inquiry form different from a wedding photography questionnaire?
faq_plan.a: An inquiry form comes before booking and asks only what you need to quote: the date, the venue, and the hours. A wedding photography questionnaire comes after booking and covers the day itself. If you also need billing and mailing details, collect them between the two in a welcome form that works like a client onboarding questionnaire.

faq_plan.q: How do I get couples to return the wedding photography questionnaire on time?
faq_plan.a: Give the couple a due date when you send it, and keep the form short enough to finish in one sitting. Ask both partners to answer together, since the family list needs both sides. If Emergent builds the questionnaire, the app can email the couple a reminder on the day you choose.

faq_plan.q: Is a fillable form better than a document for a wedding photography questionnaire?
faq_plan.a: For planning, yes. With a wedding photography questionnaire pdf, the couple fills it in and emails it back, and you copy the answers into your plan. When Emergent builds it as a form, the app saves each couple's answers to a database you own and can check a time or a list while they type.

faq_plan.q: Can I reuse a wedding photography questionnaire for other kinds of shoots?
faq_plan.a: Parts of it, yes. The contact and timing questions carry over to engagement and family sessions, while the formals and vendor sections do not. For a company's headshots or a brand session, start from a brand questionnaire instead, since it asks about the company's look and where the photos will appear.

findings.issue: The page contradicts itself on what this questionnaire is. Tab 1 shows a couple who have not booked using it as an inquiry form, but FAQ 7 says 'An inquiry form comes before booking... A wedding photography questionnaire comes after booking and covers the day itself', FAQ 4 says couples fill it 'After they book, once the wedding photography contract is signed', and howto_step_7_title says '07 Send the link once the date is booked'.
